rationale: Playbook PG-TAMP-001 matched on alert ALRT-0017. The principal carol.tan@eproc.test issued write statements against public.payments in session 99dff6d4-2580-4ef4-98ed-4371902ef21b. The standing playbook for integrity tampering snapshots the affected rows, removes the write grant from role dba, and terminates the session's backends so that no further writes land before an investigator reviews the snapshot.
rollback:
GRANT INSERT, UPDATE ON public.payments TO dba;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS incident_snapshot_alrt_0017;

alert_summary.rule_name: DELETE or UPDATE without predicate or with mass row impact

evidence.statement: SELECT count(*) FROM payments WHERE paid_at < now() - interval '700 days'
DELETE FROM payments WHERE paid_at < now() - interval '700 days'

baseline_context.note: Role dba normally returns about 372 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
